chosen.title: The Proteins That Never Were: How AI Is Designing Life's Machinery From Scratch
chosen.rationale: De novo protein and enzyme design is the hottest science-AI story of 2026 — ESM3, OpenCRISPR-1 (a working CRISPR enzyme invented by a language model), GENzyme, and the new 'Sparks' multi-agent system that autonomously discovers design rules mean AI is now inventing biological machinery that evolution never made. It's mechanism-rich, wonder-driven bioengineering that lands dead-center in Kenji's beat, and nothing on the covered list touches designed-from-scratch proteins (Precision Medicine and The Healing Machine are about diagnosis/treatment, not molecular invention).

rejected_candidates.title: Taming the Star: How AI Plasma Control Is Finally Dragging Fusion Onto the Grid
rejected_candidates.rationale: 2026 is the year fusion crossed from physics demo to grid contracts — Commonwealth Fusion pledging power to PJM, General Fusion and China's EAST milestones, and AI-driven magnetic optimization making once-hopeless stellarator designs feasible. The AI-controls-the-plasma angle is exactly Kenji's clean-energy-with-honest-mechanics lane, and it's distinct from the covered #31 'Living Battery' (microbes) and #27 'Power Hungry' (AI's carbon cost).

sources.name: Earth911 — The State of Fusion Energy in 2026: Real Reactors, Real Grids

rejected_candidates.title: Print the Factory: The Swarm Robots 3D-Printing Manufacturing On Demand
rejected_candidates.rationale: Additive manufacturing decisively flipped from prototyping to production in 2026, with AI-orchestrated 'production cells' and cooperative swarm 3D-printing robots that build big structures together while machine-vision self-inspects every layer. It's tactile, buildable, maker-culture catnip — Kenji's advanced-manufacturing beat — and the covered list has no 3D-printing/additive-manufacturing piece at all.
